name: connect-without-timers-refused

graded_by.test: worker/tests/test_control.py — a connect without timers, buffer_bytes or input_frame_max is answered error bad_request and opens nothing

description: A v0.2 worker has no value of its own for the timers, buffer_bytes or input_frame_max, and a default in its code is what decision 5.36 forbids: it refuses a connect that lacks them with error bad_request and opens no transport. The fields are optional in the schema only so that a v0.1 connect stays valid (immortality §6.4: additive).

msg.message: connect lacks timers, buffer_bytes and input_frame_max
